description: This file defines a singleton class 'PersistenceController' for managing Core Data persistent storage in a Swift iOS application. It sets up the Core Data stack, loads persistent stores, handles in-memory configurations, and provides methods for creating background contexts.

classes.name: PersistenceController
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for setting up and managing the Core Data stack, including loading persistent stores, handling in-memory setup, and providing background contexts.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the PersistenceController, sets up the NSPersistentContainer, handles in-memory configuration, and loads persistent stores.

methods.name: newBackgroundContext
methods.description: Creates and returns a new background NSManagedObjectContext with merge policy set.
